digest.component_or_area: test harness, conftest guards, e2e browser probe diagnostics
propositions: Detached pytest runs report errors (REPO_ROOT leaks, browser probe failures) that do not reproduce in foreground runs, causing agents to waste time chasing phantom regressions

The leaf cause is not detachment itself but concurrent external mutations to the checkout (file creation, process reaping, branch changes) that are only possible while detached because a foreground run blocks the mutating agent
The _no_repo_root_leaks guard misattributes external mutations to innocent tests and silently deletes new top-level files created by concurrent processes, destroying an agent's work

The browser e2e failure diagnostic reports empty stderr when a child process is signal-killed but does not inspect proc.returncode, making a reaped runner indistinguishable from a real product failure
Detached runs are trustworthy when the checkout is not mutated concurrently; the documented practice is entirely absent from local-dev guidance, leaving agents to folklore

The guards' messages must distinguish between in-test mutations and concurrent external causes, and the returncode diagnostic must name signal-killed children, to stop eroding the signal integrity of the test suite
